title: Workspace roles
description: Share a workspace as owner, member or read-only. Read-only is enforced in the Firestore rules — not just hidden in the UI — and owners can change any member's role from workspace settings.

title: Invitations can be accepted
description: Accepting an invitation had never completed: joining needs a write only the workspace owner is allowed to make, so every acceptance failed halfway and left the invitee listed but locked out. Acceptance now runs server-side in a single atomic step, and existing half-applied invitations repair themselves.

title: Connect Claude over MCP
description: Stacky now runs a hosted MCP server, so you can create, update, comment on and close tasks straight from Claude Code or Claude Desktop. Generate a token in the app; it is scoped to your account and revocable at any time.

title: An Overview that explains itself
description: The dashboard is now the home page and writes a plain-language reading of your workload — what is stalling, what changed since last time — refreshing on a timer with past readings you can page back through.

title: AI focus and prioritisation
description: Stacky reads your open work and names the one task to start next, with reasons. It proposes priority changes and applies them only once you agree, with an auto-apply toggle when you would rather it just decide.
